description: Permission denied - user authenticated but not authorized

diagnostic_steps.rationale: Custom error messages are unique identifiers leading to exact source
Custom middleware often blocks before DRF permission classes

diagnostic_steps.command: Read user creation code, check is_staff/is_superuser flags

common_bugs.symptom: getattr(user, 'profile', None) returns None but DoesNotExist raised
common_bugs.cause: Reverse OneToOne relations raise DoesNotExist, not return None

common_bugs.symptom: Admin users blocked despite having is_superuser=True
common_bugs.cause: RBAC middleware doesn't check is_superuser when employee_profile missing
common_bugs.fix: Add fallback: if user.is_superuser or user.is_staff: return True

common_bugs.symptom: User with is_superuser=True blocked by IsAdminUser
common_bugs.cause: DRF IsAdminUser checks is_staff, not is_superuser
common_bugs.fix: Set is_staff=True for admin users OR use custom permission class
